description: Initial data-quality contract for the supplied training CSV. Missing income/dependents stay null; unusual numeric values stay observable. No imputation, clipping, scaling, splitting or model fitting.

fields.name: row_id
fields.description: Original unnamed CSV row identifier; provenance/deduplication only, excluded from model features.

fields.name: SeriousDlqin2yrs
fields.description: Binary outcome; missing or nonbinary labels quarantine the record.

fields.name: RevolvingUtilizationOfUnsecuredLines
fields.description: Nonnegative utilization ratio. Values above one are flagged and retained, never automatically clipped.

fields.name: age
fields.description: Positive recorded age; zero is an explicit hard error in this initial contract. No arbitrary upper-age cutoff.

fields.name: NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse
fields.description: Nonnegative integer count. Observed 96/98 values are flagged for review without asserting that they are missing-value codes.

fields.name: DebtRatio
fields.description: Nonnegative ratio with no arbitrary maximum; values above one remain valid.

fields.name: MonthlyIncome
fields.description: Missing income remains null with a warning. Invalid nonmissing or negative values quarantine the record.

fields.name: NumberOfTimes90DaysLate
fields.description: Nonnegative integer count; 96/98 are retained with review flags.

fields.name: NumberOfTime60-89DaysPastDueNotWorse
fields.description: Nonnegative integer count; 96/98 are retained with review flags.

fields.name: NumberOfDependents
fields.description: Missing count remains null with a warning; nonmissing values must be nonnegative integers.
